changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.79[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt now shows what you are watching, while you watch it[/COLOR]
-The add-on only ever spoke to Trakt when playback stopped, so trakt.tv never showed the film or episode you had running. It now sends the start of playback as soon as the video is up, and your profile shows it as watching, with the progress bar moving on its own.
-Resuming after a pause tells Trakt you are watching again, so the site follows a paused-and-resumed session correctly.
-Pausing now saves your position to Trakt straight away, instead of waiting for you to stop. That position is what feeds Continue Watching on the site and on your other devices.
-Leaving a video by skipping to the next item in a playlist, or by closing Kodi mid-playback, used to tell Trakt nothing at all and lost the whole session. Both now save your position on the way out.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes to how Trakt is told about a playback[/COLOR]
-Starting a video used to delete your saved Trakt position before anything was written back, so stopping early left you with nothing. Trakt clears that position itself when playback starts, so the separate delete - and the busy spinner it flashed over the start of the video - is gone.
-An episode was identified to Trakt by its TVDb number alone. A show without one failed silently. All the identifiers the add-on holds are now sent together, as they already were for SIMKL.
-A film or episode could be recorded twice in your Trakt history for a single viewing, because two independent parts of the add-on were both marking it watched. Only the scrobble does it now.
-Trakt answers with a conflict code when the same item was just recorded. That was being read as a failure, which skipped the local tidy-up and put a false error on screen. It is now understood for what it is.
-The scrobble failure notice ignored the notification toggle and appeared even with notifications turned off.
[COLOR fffdb515]Quiet scrobbling for MDBList[/COLOR]
-MDBList had a switch for its scrobble notification, but it was never shown in settings, so turning the notification off meant turning scrobbling off with it. The switch now sits under MDBList scrobbling, the same way Trakt and SIMKL have had it: your viewing still reaches your account, without the pop-up over the video.
[COLOR fffdb515]Also[/COLOR]
-Every Trakt scrobble now leaves a line in the Kodi log with the server's reply code, whether or not debug logging is on. Until now this part of the add-on was completely silent, and a scrobble that never left the device looked exactly like one that worked.
